story.title: Lawsuit Alleges Illegal Agreement Among Major AI Companies to Slow Development
story.summary: A lawsuit has been filed claiming that Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google engaged in an illegal agreement to coordinate efforts to slow down AI development. The lawsuit argues that this collaboration violates antitrust laws and could diminish the value of AI subscriptions for consumers.

timeline_highlights.title: Anthropic Researcher Warns of AI Threat to Humanity
timeline_highlights.summary: A researcher from Anthropic has stated there is more than a 10% chance that artificial intelligence could lead to human extinction within the next decade. This warning follows the resignation of a colleague who expressed similar concerns about the rapid development of superintelligent AI that may surpass human control. Experts emphasize the seriousness of these risks, given their access to unreleased AI systems.
key_facts: Anthropic researcher estimates over 10% chance AI could kill all humans.
Concerns arise from the rapid advancement of AI technology.
A colleague resigned over fears of out-of-control AI.

timeline_highlights.title: Trump Dismisses AI Safety Concerns Amid Industry Warnings
timeline_highlights.summary: President Trump has rejected calls for increased oversight of artificial intelligence, labeling concerns about its risks as part of a 'sick conspiracy.' This response follows warnings from industry leaders, including Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who argue that the rapid advancement of AI technology poses significant threats to society. The debate highlights ongoing tensions between technological progress and safety measures.

Trump referred to concerns over rogue AI as a 'hoax.'

These reports raise significant questions regarding the safety and reliability of advanced AI systems. The organization has committed to tracking these incidents more closely as discussions around AI safety intensify.

related_stories.title: Panic and Protests Follow Deaths of Miners in Nigerian Custody
related_stories.summary: In Nigeria's Minna, 37 suspected illegal goldminers died in a prison cell, prompting panic among survivors who struggled to breathe. Protests erupted in response, leading police to fire teargas and impose an overnight curfew. Armed security forces have been deployed to manage the unrest following the incident, which has drawn significant public outcry.

related_stories.title: Congo Initiates Ebola Vaccination for Health Workers Amid Outbreak
related_stories.summary: Congo has commenced an Ebola vaccination campaign for health workers in Bunia, the epicenter of the country's most severe outbreak. The Ervebo vaccine, previously effective against other strains of the virus, is being prioritized for frontline responders.
